cloud-operating-model.code:
THRESHOLD = 1.0
CONSECUTIVE = 2

DEPLOYS = [
    ("v2.3.0", [0.2, 0.3, 0.4, 0.3, 0.2, 0.3, 0.2, 0.4, 0.3, 0.2]),
    ("v2.4.0", [0.3, 0.8, 1.4, 2.6, 6.1, 5.8, 4.9, 3.2, 1.1, 0.7]),
    ("v2.4.1", [0.4, 1.2, 0.6, 1.3, 0.8, 1.1, 0.9, 0.5, 0.4, 0.3]),
]

print(f"== rollback trigger: >{THRESHOLD}% for {CONSECUTIVE} consecutive minutes ==")

def evaluate_deploys(deploys):
    promoted = 0
    rolled_back = 0
    for name, rates in deploys:
        peak = max(rates)
        breaches = sum(1 for r in rates if r > THRESHOLD)
        streak = 0
        fired_at = None
        for minute, rate in enumerate(rates, start=1):
            if rate > THRESHOLD:
                streak += 1
                if streak >= CONSECUTIVE and fired_at is None:
                    fired_at = minute
            else:
                streak = 0
        if fired_at is not None:
            rolled_back += 1
            print(f"{name} peak={peak:.1f}% breaches={breaches} -> ROLLBACK at minute {fired_at}")
        elif breaches > 0:
            promoted += 1
            print(f"{name} peak={peak:.1f}% breaches={breaches} -> PROMOTE (no consecutive breach)")
        else:
            promoted += 1
            print(f"{name} peak={peak:.1f}% breaches={breaches} -> PROMOTE")
    print(f"verdicts: {promoted} promoted, {rolled_back} rolled back")

evaluate_deploys(DEPLOYS)

linux-processes-ports.code:
import re

SS_OUTPUT = '''LISTEN 0 4096 0.0.0.0:8080 users:(("gunicorn",pid=1337,fd=6))
LISTEN 0 511 0.0.0.0:443 users:(("nginx",pid=812,fd=8))
LISTEN 0 4096 127.0.0.1:5432 users:(("postgres",pid=433,fd=5))'''

PS_TABLE = {
    1337: ("gunicorn: orders v2.3.9", 901),
    812: ("nginx: master process", 1),
    433: ("postgres -D /var/lib/postgresql/data", 1),
    901: ("systemd --user", 1),
}

TARGET_PORT = 8080

def build_port_map(ss_output, ps_table, target_port):
    collision = None
    for line in ss_output.strip().splitlines():
        addr = line.split()[3]
        port = int(addr.rsplit(":", 1)[1])
        m = re.search(r'pid=(\d+)', line)
        pid = int(m.group(1))
        cmd, ppid = ps_table[pid]
        print(f"port {port} -> pid {pid} ({cmd})")
        if port == target_port:
            collision = (port, pid, cmd, ppid)
    port, pid, cmd, ppid = collision
    print(f"collision on {port}: {cmd} (pid {pid}, parent {ppid})")
    print(f"action: stop pid {pid} via its supervisor, re-check ss, then start v2.4.0")

build_port_map(SS_OUTPUT, PS_TABLE, TARGET_PORT)

LAYERS = [
    ("FROM python:3.12-slim@sha256:9c3a54e0", "base-9c3a54e0", 4, "builder"),
    ("COPY requirements.txt .", "reqs-8d21", 1, "builder"),
    ("RUN pip install -r requirements.txt", "pip-of-reqs-8d21", 48, "builder"),
    ("COPY src/ ./src", "src-tree-51ec", 2, "builder"),
    ("FROM slim AS runtime + COPY --from=builder", "runtime-of-builder", 6, "runtime"),
]

SIZES = {"base-9c3a54e0": 121, "reqs-8d21": 1, "pip-of-reqs-8d21": 380, "src-tree-51ec": 12, "runtime-of-builder": 142}

CHANGES = {"src-tree-51ec": "src-tree-9fb0"}

def simulate_rebuild(layers, changes):
    print("== build 2 (src changed) ==")
    parent_rebuilt = False
    hits = rebuilds = rebuild_time = full_time = 0
    runtime_mb = 0
    for i, (instr, key, secs, stage) in enumerate(layers, start=1):
        full_time += secs
        if stage == "runtime":
            runtime_mb += SIZES[key]
        if parent_rebuilt:
            print(f"{i} {instr} REBUILD (parent rebuilt)")
            rebuilds += 1
            rebuild_time += secs
        elif key in changes:
            print(f"{i} {instr} REBUILD (input changed)")
            rebuilds += 1
            rebuild_time += secs
            parent_rebuilt = True
        else:
            print(f"{i} {instr} HIT")
            hits += 1
    print(f"cache: {hits} hit / {rebuilds} rebuilt, rebuild time {rebuild_time}s (full build {full_time}s)")
    print(f"runtime image ships {runtime_mb}MB (builder stage discarded)")

simulate_rebuild(LAYERS, CHANGES)

ci-pipeline-quality-gates.code:
FLOOR = 80.0

COMMITS = [
    ("c1a9f", 212, 212, 84.2, 0),
    ("d4e02", 211, 212, 85.1, 0),
    ("e77b3", 208, 208, 76.5, 0),
    ("f19c4", 215, 215, 81.0, 2),
]

def run_gates(commits):
    promoted = 0
    for sha, passed, total, coverage, criticals in commits:
        parts = []
        if passed != total:
            parts.append(f"tests {passed}/{total} FAIL ({total - passed} failing)")
            print(f"{sha}: " + ", ".join(parts) + " -> BLOCKED at gate:tests")
            continue
        parts.append(f"tests {passed}/{total} OK")
        if coverage < FLOOR:
            parts.append(f"coverage {coverage:.1f}% FAIL (floor {FLOOR:.0f}%)")
            print(f"{sha}: " + ", ".join(parts) + " -> BLOCKED at gate:coverage")
            continue
        parts.append(f"coverage {coverage:.1f}% OK")
        if criticals != 0:
            parts.append(f"vulns {criticals} FAIL")
            print(f"{sha}: " + ", ".join(parts) + " -> BLOCKED at gate:vulns")
            continue
        parts.append(f"vulns {criticals} OK")
        promoted += 1
        print(f"{sha}: " + ", ".join(parts) + " -> PROMOTE")
    print(f"promoted: {promoted}/{len(commits)}")

run_gates(COMMITS)

artifact-versioning-releases.code:
BUILDS = {
    "v1.4.1": ("sha256:77c40d18", "e8a2b91", True),
    "v1.4.2": ("sha256:b7e1a2c9", "9f31c2d", True),
    "v1.5.0-rc1": ("sha256:a03df512", "41c7aa0", True),
}

TAGS = {"latest": "v1.5.0-rc1"}

PROMOTIONS = [
    ("staging", "v1.4.1"), ("prod", "v1.4.1"),
    ("staging", "v1.4.2"), ("prod", "v1.4.2"),
    ("staging", "v1.5.0-rc1"),
]

def resolve_release_state():
    prod_history = [ver for env, ver in PROMOTIONS if env == "prod"]
    prod_ver = prod_history[-1]
    prod_digest, prod_git, _ = BUILDS[prod_ver]
    print(f"prod is {prod_ver} -> {prod_digest} (git {prod_git})")
    latest_ver = TAGS["latest"]
    latest_digest = BUILDS[latest_ver][0]
    if latest_digest != prod_digest:
        print(f":latest -> {latest_digest} ({latest_ver}, NOT what prod runs)")
    else:
        print(f":latest -> {latest_digest} ({latest_ver}, matches prod)")
    prev_ver = prod_history[-2]
    prev_digest, _, prev_retained = BUILDS[prev_ver]
    print(f"rollback target: {prev_ver} -> {prev_digest} retained={'yes' if prev_retained else 'no'}")
    if latest_digest != prod_digest:
        print("tag drift: :latest != prod digest")

resolve_release_state()

deployment-strategies.code:
STEPS = [5, 25, 50, 100]
GATE_PCT = 1.0
REQS_PER_STEP = 40000

RELEASES = [
    ("v7.2.0", [0.3, 0.4, 0.4, 0.5]),
    ("v7.3.0", [0.8, 3.2]),
]

def run_canary(name, step_rates):
    trail = []
    absorbed = 0.0
    exposed = 0.0
    bigbang = 0.0
    outcome = "PROMOTED"
    halted_at = None
    for share, rate in zip(STEPS, step_rates):
        canary_reqs = REQS_PER_STEP * share / 100.0
        bigbang += REQS_PER_STEP * rate / 100.0
        if rate > GATE_PCT:
            trail.append(f"{share}% BREACH({rate}%)")
            absorbed += canary_reqs * rate / 100.0
            exposed += canary_reqs
            outcome = "ROLLBACK"
            halted_at = share
            break
        trail.append(f"{share}% OK({rate}%)")
        absorbed += canary_reqs * rate / 100.0
        exposed += canary_reqs
    if outcome == "PROMOTED":
        print(f"release {name}: " + " -> ".join(trail) + " => PROMOTED")
    else:
        print(f"release {name}: " + " -> ".join(trail) + f" => ROLLBACK at {halted_at}%")
    print(f"bad requests absorbed: {round(absorbed)} of {round(exposed)} exposed (canary path)")
    print(f"same defect big-bang: {round(bigbang)} bad requests (100% exposure, all steps)")

for name, rates in RELEASES:
    run_canary(name, rates)

EVENTS = [
    ("02:02", "deploy"),
    ("02:14", "alert"),
    ("02:15", "ack"),
    ("02:17", "rollback_cmd"),
    ("02:19", "recovered"),
]

REVISIONS = [
    (39, "v2.3.7", 11),
    (40, "v2.3.8", 1),
    (41, "v2.3.9", 6),
    (42, "v2.4.0", 0),
]

def minutes(hhmm):
    h, m = hhmm.split(":")
    return int(h) * 60 + int(m)

def analyze_incident(events, revisions):
    t = {kind: minutes(ts) for ts, kind in events}
    detect = t["alert"] - t["deploy"]
    decide = t["rollback_cmd"] - t["alert"]
    recover = t["recovered"] - t["rollback_cmd"]
    mttr = t["recovered"] - t["deploy"]
    print(f"detect: {detect} min (deploy -> alert)")
    print(f"decide: {decide} min (alert -> rollback_cmd)")
    print(f"recover: {recover} min (rollback_cmd -> recovered)")
    print(f"mttr: {mttr} min total (deploy -> recovered)")
    target = None
    for rev, ver, clean in revisions[:-1]:
        if clean >= 2:
            target = (rev, ver, clean)
    print(f"rollback target: rev {target[0]} ({target[1]}, clean {target[2]}d)")
    phases = [("detection", detect, "invest in faster signal"),
              ("decision", decide, "pre-agree the trigger"),
              ("recovery", recover, "drill the rollback path")]
    name, dur, advice = max(phases, key=lambda p: p[1])
    print(f"autopsy: {name} dominated ({dur} of {mttr} min) -> {advice}")

analyze_incident(EVENTS, REVISIONS)

cost-capacity-finops.code:
import math

TARGET_UTIL_PCT = 60.0
MIN_REPLICAS = 3

SERVICES = [
    ("orders", 9400, 12, 41.0, 34.0),
    ("search", 6200, 8, 89.3, 58.0),
    ("batch-etl", 4100, 6, 2.2, 22.0),
]

def rightsize_fleet(services):
    total_savings = 0
    total_spend = 0
    resized = []
    for name, cost, replicas, req_m, peak in services:
        total_spend += cost
        unit = cost / (req_m * 1000)
        target = math.ceil(replicas * peak / TARGET_UTIL_PCT)
        target = max(target, MIN_REPLICAS)
        if target < replicas:
            new_cost = cost * target / replicas
            saves = round(cost - new_cost)
            total_savings += saves
            resized.append(target)
            print(f"{name}: ${cost}/mo, {req_m}M req, ${unit:.3f}/1k req, peak {peak:.0f}% -> resize {replicas} -> {target} replicas (saves ${saves}/mo)")
        else:
            print(f"{name}: ${cost}/mo, {req_m}M req, ${unit:.3f}/1k req, peak {peak:.0f}% -> keep {replicas} replicas (no safe cut)")
    pct = 100.0 * total_savings / total_spend
    print(f"fleet savings: ${total_savings}/mo of ${total_spend}/mo ({pct:.1f}%) with the SLO floor intact")
    print(f"guard: HPA minReplicas={','.join(str(r) for r in resized)} per resized service, revert if p99 breaches 10 min")

rightsize_fleet(SERVICES)

PIPELINES = [
    ("v3.1.0", [
        ("dev", "sha256:c41b", True, "smoke 34/34"),
        ("staging", "sha256:c41b", True, "p99 231ms"),
        ("prod-canary", "sha256:c41b", True, "error 0.3%"),
    ]),
    ("v3.2.0", [
        ("dev", "sha256:990a", True, "smoke 34/34"),
        ("staging", "sha256:2f77", True, "p99 240ms"),
    ]),
    ("v3.3.0", [
        ("dev", "sha256:8813", True, "smoke 34/34"),
        ("staging", "sha256:8813", False, "p99 812ms > 400ms gate"),
    ]),
]

def run_promotions(pipelines):
    promoted = halted = 0
    for version, stages in pipelines:
        first_digest = stages[0][1]
        trail = []
        verdict = None
        for env, digest, ok, detail in stages:
            if digest != first_digest:
                verdict = f"{version}: dev {first_digest} -> {env} {digest} REBUILD DETECTED -> HALT ({env} tested different bytes)"
                break
            if not ok:
                trail.append(f"{env} FAIL ({detail})")
                verdict = f"{version} ({first_digest}): " + " -> ".join(trail) + f" -> HALTED at {env}"
                break
            trail.append(f"{env} OK")
        if verdict is None:
            verdict = f"{version} ({first_digest}): " + " -> ".join(trail) + " -> PROMOTED (same digest end to end)"
            promoted += 1
        else:
            halted += 1
        print(verdict)
    print(f"promoted: {promoted}/{len(pipelines)}, halted: {halted}")

run_promotions(PIPELINES)

cloud-devops-capstone.code:
BURN_RATE = 12
MTTR_BAR_MIN = 15

CONTROLS = [
    ("gate-ci", "ci_gate_block"),
    ("gate-canary", "canary_gate_pass"),
    ("signal-burn", "burn_page"),
    ("rollback-pinned", "rollback_pinned"),
    ("budget-ledger", "budget_verified"),
]

EVENTS = [
    ("16:35", "ci_gate_block", "blocked f31ab at coverage 76%"),
    ("16:51", "canary_gate_pass", "per-version error 0.4% at 5%"),
    ("16:58", "deploy", "v2.4 rev 18 at 100%"),
    ("17:03", "alert", "slo-burn-fast 12x"),
    ("17:03", "burn_page", "page: burn 12x, budget ~60h, suspect 16:58"),
    ("17:06", "rollback_cmd", "undo --to-revision=17"),
    ("17:06", "rollback_pinned", "target rev 17, clean 6d"),
    ("17:08", "recovered", "burn < 1x, two windows"),
    ("17:20", "budget_verified", "0.12 budget-min spent, snapshot attached"),
]

def minutes(hhmm):
    h, m = hhmm.split(":")
    return int(h) * 60 + int(m)

def score_operability(events):
    by_kind = {}
    for ts, kind, detail in events:
        by_kind.setdefault(kind, (ts, detail))
    missing = []
    for name, kind in CONTROLS:
        if kind in by_kind:
            print(f"{name}: fired ({by_kind[kind][1]})")
        else:
            print(f"{name}: NOT FIRED")
            missing.append(name)
    t = {k: minutes(v[0]) for k, v in by_kind.items()}
    detect = t["alert"] - t["deploy"]
    decide = t["rollback_cmd"] - t["alert"]
    recover = t["recovered"] - t["rollback_cmd"]
    mttr = t["recovered"] - t["deploy"]
    print(f"detect: {detect} min, decide: {decide} min, recover: {recover} min, mttr: {mttr} min")
    spent = mttr * BURN_RATE * 0.001
    pct = 100.0 * spent / 43.2
    print(f"budget spent: {spent:.2f} of 43.2 min ({pct:.1f}%)")
    if not missing and mttr <= MTTR_BAR_MIN:
        print(f"verdict: OPERABLE (5/5 controls fired, mttr {mttr} <= {MTTR_BAR_MIN} min)")
    elif missing:
        print(f"verdict: NOT OPERABLE (controls not fired: {', '.join(missing)})")
    else:
        print(f"verdict: NOT OPERABLE (mttr {mttr} > {MTTR_BAR_MIN} min)")

score_operability(EVENTS)
